# 1 Clement Chapter 63 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 63 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_063_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 63

**63:1** Given so many great examples before us, it is right that we bow our necks in submission — that is, practice obedience — so that, putting the pointless rebellion behind us, we may reach our goal in truth, free from any blame.

**63:2** If you obey what we have written through the Holy Spirit — if you tear out by the root the lawless passion of your jealousy, in keeping with the appeal for peace and harmony we have set down in this letter — you will bring us great joy and gladness.

**63:3** We have also sent to you trustworthy and wise men who have lived blamelessly among us from their youth to old age, and they will serve as witnesses between you and us.

**63:4** We have done this so that you will know that our complete and only concern has been — and still is — that you find peace quickly.

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the spirit of Clement's pastoral appeal.*
